_doc: Tells (Dungeon Alive slice 5; known and unknown 2026-11-12; src/tells.py). Brandon: players must pay attention to lore, weaknesses and abilities (stay away from things that confuse; use ranged), and the notes must not give away what a creature is or how to beat it before the hero knows it. Each tell has three parts: 'sign' (what the eye sees), 'does' (what the creature can do to him), 'counter' (what to do about it). How much is said follows family_lore.knowledge: UNKNOWN hears the sign; KIN (its family at Recognise or Forewarned, the kind itself never studied) the sign, 'kin_lead' and what it does; KNOWN (studied, its page opened, or its family at Lore) all three, then 'weak_one'/'weak_many' with its weaknesses. A sign never names the mechanic or the counter. The counter is honest about reach: when the creature can put the effect on the hero from across a room (tells.reach), 'counter_far' is used, or 'far_counter' when the tell has none. 'splits' fills {split_by} from the creature's own splits.by; 'does_weak'/'counter_weak' are for a creature split by a weak blow. The first time in a run the hero sees a kind, its worst tell is said at what he knows; it is said again when he comes to know the kind better. Observe (O) says up to 'max_lines' of them. 'order' ranks the effects, worst first; 'min_chance' ignores an attack effect rarer than this.
far_counter: It can reach you from across a room, but only where it can see you: keep stone between you until you can close in.

gaze_paralyze.sign: Something about the eyes of {the} makes you want to look away.
gaze_paralyze.does: Its gaze can hold you where you stand, from across a room.
gaze_paralyze.counter: Keep a wall or a pillar between you. Eyes that cannot see are safe from it, and so is a hero behind the Aegis of Athena.

paralyzed.sign: {The} moves slowly and surely, like a thing that never has to chase its prey.
paralyzed.does: It can hold you still where you stand.
paralyzed.counter: Do not let it reach you: fight it from a distance.

confused.sign: Looking at {the} too long makes the room tilt.
confused.does: It can scramble your thoughts until you cannot think straight.
confused.counter: Keep your distance, or end it fast.

sleeping.sign: Just watching {the} makes your eyelids heavy.
sleeping.does: It can put you to sleep where you stand.
sleeping.counter: Never fight it with others close by.

frozen.does: It can freeze you solid, and frozen, you cannot fight back.

teleportitis.does: It can fling you somewhere else on the floor, far from your way out.

feared.sign: Looking at {the} makes your stomach drop.
feared.does: It can break your nerve and send you running.
feared.counter: Know where you would run before you fight it.

blinded.sign: Everything about {the} seems aimed at your eyes.
blinded.does: It can blind you, and a blind hero fights by touch alone.

silenced.sign: {The} moves in a pocket of dead quiet.
silenced.does: It can take your voice, and your spells with it.
silenced.counter: Cast before it reaches you, or fight it with steel.
silenced.counter_far: Fight it with steel, not spells.

stunned.sign: {The} is built like a falling wall.
stunned.does: Its blows can leave you dazed.
stunned.counter: Do not trade blows with it for long.

immobilized.does: It can pin you where you stand.
immobilized.counter: Pinned, you cannot run: fight it only where you would not need to.
immobilized.counter_far: Pinned, you cannot run: fight it only where you would not need to.

splits.sign: {The} looks as if it would come apart and keep coming.
splits.does: Strike it with {split_by} and there will be two.
splits.does_weak: Strike it with a weak blow and there will be two.
splits.counter_weak: Hit it hard, or not at all.

revive_once_on_death.sign: The wounds on {the} should have killed it, and did not.
revive_once_on_death.does: It will not stay dead the first time.
revive_once_on_death.counter: When it falls, keep your guard up.

drain_heals_self.sign: {The} watches your throat, not your blade.
drain_heals_self.does: It heals itself on your blood: every blow it lands mends it.
drain_heals_self.counter: Do not trade blows with it.

weakened.does: It can drain the strength out of you.
weakened.counter: Fight it fast, or from afar.

diseased.does: The wounds it gives fester long after the fight.
diseased.counter: Kill it before it lands many.

poisoned.does: It is poisonous, and every wound it gives keeps hurting after.
poisoned.counter: Do not let it land many.

regeneration.sign: The old scars of {the} have closed without a mark.
regeneration.does: It heals itself as it fights.
regeneration.counter: Finish it; do not wear it down.

summon_kind.sign: {The} keeps glancing behind it, as if it expects company.
summon_kind.does: It can call others to it.

pull_chance.sign: {The} has a long reach with a hook to it.
pull_chance.does: It will drag you to it from further off than you think.
pull_chance.counter: Stay well out of its reach, or close in on your own terms.

sp_drain.does: It is after your food: every blow it lands leaves you hungrier.

can_charge.does: Across open ground it will charge.
can_charge.counter: Make it come to you round a corner.

can_phase_blink.sign: {The} is never quite where you last looked.
can_phase_blink.does: It steps from place to place without crossing between.
can_phase_blink.counter: Distance will not save you: stand and fight.

bleeding.does: The wounds it gives go on bleeding after the blow.
bleeding.counter: Do not let it land many.

burning.does: It sets what it hits alight, and the fire keeps burning after.

slowed.sign: The air round {the} feels thick, like wading.
slowed.does: It can slow you, and slowed, you cannot outrun it.
slowed.counter: Choose to fight or flee before it reaches you.

hallucinating.does: It fills heads with things that are not there, and while it lasts, what you see may not be what is there.

rust.sign: Every nail and hinge near {the} has gone to red dust.
rust.does: Its feelers rust iron and steel: a brush takes a point off your weapon or armour.
rust.counter: Keep good steel out of its reach: fight it with wood or bronze.
